      "operation": "Call ucl_parser_free before returning from a failed ucl_parser_add_string call.",
      "condition": "ucl_parser_get_error reports a parse error.",
      "capability": "Release the parser and its owned state with ucl_parser_free.",
      "consequence": "The parser and its owned state remain allocated.",
      "equivalence_reason": "All five describe the same error-branch cleanup obligation; they differ in how confidently they establish a reachable error."
    },

      "operation": "Construct the string parser with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS enabled.",
      "condition": "Input comments are parsed through the supported saved-comment mode.",
      "capability": "Save and attach comments during string parsing.",
      "consequence": "The harness cannot exercise saved-comment behavior.",
      "equivalence_reason": "Each identifies the fixed zero flags passed to ucl_parser_new as the obstacle to the same parser mode."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["5d2d7736ea3946ace946"],
      "operation": "Clean up an orphan parser->last_comment in ucl_state_machine or ucl_parser_free.",
      "condition": "A saved comment remains orphaned when parsing ends or the parser is freed.",
      "capability": "Release the orphan comment through the applicable cleanup path.",
      "consequence": "The orphan comment remains allocated.",
      "equivalence_reason": "This candidate spans terminal parsing and parser destruction, so its trigger and operation do not exactly match the narrower destructor candidates."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["5327bf7aa765e3a69691", "92526fb0af88b58c6251"],
      "operation": "Release a terminal orphan parser->last_comment and subsequently call ucl_parser_free.",
      "condition": "The terminal path has already released the comment.",
      "capability": "Prevent a second ucl_object_unref of the released comment.",
      "consequence": "A second release could corrupt memory.",
      "equivalence_reason": "Both address duplicate release of the same terminal orphan during later parser destruction."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["a03096558599368d3b15", "487761951c9bc44d76d0"],
      "operation": "Call ucl_parser_free after a parse error with parser->last_comment pending.",
      "condition": "UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS is enabled, a comment remains pending, and parsing reports an error.",
      "capability": "Reach the destructor's ucl_object_unref(parser->last_comment) cleanup.",
      "consequence": "The pending saved comment remains allocated.",
      "equivalence_reason": "Both require error-path destruction specifically to reach the new pending-comment cleanup."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["8247d998ba4ddec9607b", "61399a92a879c89129d5"],
      "operation": "Release parser->last_comment inside ucl_parser_free.",
      "condition": "Parser destruction occurs while a saved, unattached last_comment remains set.",
      "capability": "Call ucl_object_unref on the pending comment during destruction.",
      "consequence": "The pending comment remains allocated after parser destruction.",
      "equivalence_reason": "Both describe the destructor's conditional release; neither requires a parse error as its trigger."
    }
  ]
